# jamfplatform_device_shutdown (Action)

Requests that a device shut down. Requires **Device Management Actions API access**.

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Required privilege |
|---|
| `execute:pro:device-actions` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "jamfplatform_device_shutdown" "power_off" {
  config {
    device_id = "uuid-of-device-to-shutdown"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device_id` (String) Jamf Pro Management ID. Provide this or `serial_number`.
- `serial_number` (String) Device serial number (case-sensitive). Requires **Device Inventory API access** when used. Provide this or `device_id`.
